verses.text: Will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?
verses.title: Pray for Them

verses.text: For we know him who said, “It is mine to avenge; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge his people.” It is a dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
